description: A NOTAM's own card, read from its parts (FAA Order JO 7930.2): its accountability (4-2-1, "FDC"); its category, a procedure NOTAM's by what the procedures are for (SID, ODP and DVA departures, STAR arrivals, IAP approaches; 1-2-1), the rest its heading; its title, what happened ("Runway 18/36 closed"): notam_read's what, else a surface its words close (RWY, TWY; 3-3-5, 3-3-6; CLSD, JO 7340.2), else the procedures not authorized (NA); one plain sentence of its effect ("Runway 18/36 is permanently closed, so its RNAV departures are not authorized."); whether the condition is permanent (PERM, 4-2-1, or its words' PERMANENTLY), and whether it then runs until the charts are updated (an EST end, or none); and the procedures it takes away, each by its charted name and number (7-1-3: "ADELL EIGHT DEPARTURE (RNAV)" is "ADELL 8", RNAV). Each null or empty where the NOTAM's parts do not say all of it: the card then says its words written out (notam_read), never a guess.

text.description: The NOTAM as sent, domestic or ICAO form.

idents.description: The field's idents (OSH, KOSH), kept as written.

ends.description: The end the caller holds besides the text's own (the feed's), ISO 8601 UTC; a firm one keeps a permanent NOTAM whose text gives no end from being said to run until the charts are updated.

account.description: The domestic form's accountability ("FDC", "OSH"); null in the ICAO form.

category.description: What kind of thing it is about, a small label: "Departure procedures", "Arrival procedures", "Instrument approaches", else notam_read's heading (Runway, Taxiway, Navaid, Airspace ...).

title.description: What happened, the card's title: "Runway 18/36 closed"; null where its parts do not say it.

effect.description: One plain sentence of what it means: "Runway 18/36 is permanently closed, so its RNAV departures are not authorized."; null where its parts do not say it.

permanent.description: The condition is permanent: PERM as its end, or PERMANENTLY in its words (it stays until the charts show it).

until_charts.description: Its end is "until the charts are updated": a permanent condition (PERM, JO 7930.2 4-2-1) with an end marked EST, or with none, stays until the charts show it, the EST time only the estimate of when. False where its end, firm, is its end.

procedures.description: The procedures it takes away (NA), in its order; empty where it takes none.

rnav.description: An RNAV procedure, "(RNAV)" on its title.
